title: Safe blueprint parsing and output ownership
statement: A module generation request MUST accept only the bounded STYNX 1.5 JSON dialect and safe identifiers, paths, and schema names; it MUST reject unknown or unsafe input and every pre-existing output destination without changing that destination or leaving a partial result.
rationale: Strict preflight and staging prevent blueprint content or collisions from controlling source, SQL, or existing files.

strategy.rationale: CLI parser and generator tests reject malformed and expanded JSON, unsafe names, reserved schemas, path/symlink collisions, and injected output failures; the packed CLI repeats pre-existing destination negatives.
